summary: Conviction under IPC s. 302 affirmed; multiple dying declarations validated: DD-I (PW16 PCR officer), DD-II (PW18 doctor), DD-III (PW17 SI; FIR basis), DD-IV (victim's mother); consistency, voluntariness, mental fitness established; no requirement for medical attestation per Sher Singh; prosecution witnesses unchallenged; motive from workplace relationship; circumstantial evidence corroborated; High Court affirmation upheld; no merit in challenges regarding burn injury severity or procedural non-compliance with Punjab/Haryana HC rules.
legal_provisions_cited: Khushal Rao v. State of Bombay
Sher Singh v. State of Punjab
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life sentence under s. 302 IPC upheld.
